title: Training Note: Plan Standing and the Debit-Card Ceiling on Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Training note for collectors working **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It covers the plan-standing percentage of the debit-card ceiling of the day, which is decided from the account's Payment Arrangements records.

## The rule

The debit-card ceiling's plan-standing percentage is:
- **75%** where any payment plan on the account carries a broken date and 2 or more missed installments on the account's plans were recorded in the last six months;
- **90%** where any payment plan on the account carries a broken date and fewer than 2 missed installments on the account's plans were recorded in the last six months;
- **100%** where no payment plan on the account carries a broken date.

The percentage is applied to the rolling limit of the debit-card ceiling: the rolling limit is multiplied by the plan-standing percentage, and the percentage applies to no other amount.

## Questions and answers

**Which records decide the percentage?** The Payment Arrangements records of the placed account: each payment plan's broken date, and the missed-installment entries on the plan ledgers of the account's plans.

**What does "carries a broken date" mean?** The plan record shows a date on which the plan was broken. One such plan on the account is enough, whichever plan it is.

**Which missed installments are counted?** Every missed-installment entry on any of the account's plans whose record date falls in the last six months, meaning that fewer than six whole calendar months separate that date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10 an entry dated 2026-04-11 counts and one dated 2026-04-10 does not.

**Do missed installments matter when no plan carries a broken date?** No. Without a broken date on any plan the percentage is 100% however many installments were missed.

## Decision table

| A plan on the account carries a broken date | Missed installments on the account's plans in the last six months | Plan-standing percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | 75% |
| Yes | 0 or 1 | 90% |
| No | any number | 100% |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented Payment Arrangements records.*

- A Standard Installment Plan on the account was broken in June; three installments were missed in the last six months. Percentage 75%. With a hypothetical rolling limit of $3000.00 the limit is taken at $2250.00.
- The same broken plan, but only one missed installment in the last six months. Percentage 90%; a hypothetical $3000.00 rolling limit is taken at $2700.00.
- A plan on the account has two missed installments but has never been broken. Percentage 100%.
